title: Summary and review exercise
competency: Bring together the ideas of Unit 3.

keywords.def: A letter or symbol that stands for an unknown number.
An equation that can be written ax + b = 0 with a ≠ 0.
In y = mx, the number m.

en.text: A variable stands for an unknown number. Simplify expressions by collecting like terms. Solve a linear equation by doing the same to both sides. Points are (x, y); x = a and y = b are straight lines, and y = mx passes through the origin with slope m.

screens.title: Summary for unit 3
paras: A variable is a letter or symbol for an unknown number.
Like terms have the same variables and exponents.
A linear equation can be written ax + b = 0, a ≠ 0.

screens.title: Rules of the unit
screens.ask: Tap each idea to see its rule.
items: Do the same to both sides. Never multiply or divide by 0.
Move a across, then b up or down.
A line through the origin with slope m.

screens.title: Key words of the unit
defs: A letter or symbol that stands for an unknown number.
An equation that can be written ax + b = 0 with a ≠ 0.
In y = mx, the number m.

pairs: line through Quadrants I and III
line through Quadrants II and IV
screens.why:
x = 2 fixes x, so it is a vertical line.
y = −1 fixes y, so it is a horizontal line.
y = 3x has m = 3 > 0: Quadrants I and III.
y = −x has m = −1 < 0: Quadrants II and IV.
screens.text: Match each equation to its graph.
Steps for solving word problems: what comes right after "select variables"?
screens.why:
1. Read the problem. 2. Select variables.
3. Write an equation. 4. Solve it.
5. Answer in words. 6. Check.
So right after selecting a variable, write the equation.

Shift 3x to the left: 2x − 3x = −1.
−x = −1.
Divide by −1: x = 1.
Check: 2(1) = 2 and 3(1) − 1 = 2.

Divide both sides by 3: x − 8 = 7.
Add 8 to both sides: x = 15.
Check: 3(15 − 8) = 3 × 7 = 21.

items.text: Distributive property: true or false? For any integers a, b and c, a(b + c) = ab + ac.
items.why:
This is the distributive property.
Example: 2(3 + 4) = 2 × 7 = 14.
2 × 3 + 2 × 4 = 6 + 8 = 14.
True.

items.text: Count the terms: true or false? 2x² + 2xy is a trinomial.
items.why:
The terms are 2x² and 2xy.
That is two terms.
Two terms make a binomial, not a trinomial.
False.

items.text: Like terms: true or false? 3a²b and 3ab² are like terms.
items.why:
3a²b has a² and b¹.
3ab² has a¹ and b².
The exponents differ.
They are unlike terms. False.

items.text: Rules of transformation: true or false? If a = b, then a − b = 0.
items.why:
Start with a = b.
Subtract b from both sides: a − b = b − b.
b − b = 0.
So a − b = 0. True.

items.text: Graphs: true or false? The line x + y = 0 is a vertical line.
items.why:
Shift x: y = −x.
This is y = mx with m = −1.
It is a slanted line through the origin.
A vertical line has the form x = a. False.

items.text: Slope: true or false? 4 is the slope of the line y − 4x = 0.
items.why:
Shift −4x: y = 4x.
Compare with y = mx: m = 4.
True.

items.text: Coefficients: true or false? The numerical coefficient of 3xy² is 2.
items.why:
3xy² = 3 × x × y².
The number factor is 3.
The 2 is the exponent of y.
False.

items.text: Rules of transformation: true or false? If c = d, then a + c = d + a.
items.why:
Start with c = d.
Add a to both sides: a + c = a + d.
Addition order does not matter: a + d = d + a.
True.

items.text: Like terms: which pair are like terms?
items.why:
yx = xy, so −4xy and 9yx both have x¹y¹. Like!
3x² and 3x: exponents 2 and 1.
−x² and −x: exponents 2 and 1.
2ab² and 2a²b: the exponents are swapped.
Only −4xy and 9yx are like terms.

items.text: Equivalent equations: which is equivalent to −3(2x − 1) = 2x + 12?
items.why:
Remove the bracket: −3 × 2x = −6x and −3 × (−1) = +3.
So the equation becomes −6x + 3 = 2x + 12.
It is the same equation, so it is equivalent.
Its solution is x = −9/8, so x = −1 and −8x = 8 are wrong.

items.text: Solve the equation with fractions: the solution of x/2 − x = 3x/8 − 11 is:
items.why:
The LCM of 2 and 8 is 8.
Multiply every term by 8: 4x − 8x = 3x − 88.
−4x − 3x = −88, so −7x = −88.
x = 88/7.
Check: both sides equal −44/7.

items.text: Solutions: which value of x satisfies 2x = 3x − 1?
items.why:
Try x = 1: 2(1) = 2 and 3(1) − 1 = 2. Equal!
Or solve: 2x − 3x = −1, so −x = −1 and x = 1.
x = −1 gives −2 and −4: not equal.

items.text: Slope: the slope of the line y − 3x = 0 is:
items.why:
Shift −3x: y = 3x.
Compare with y = mx: m = 3.
−3 forgets that the sign changes when you shift.

items.text: Ages: a girl and her brother are 34 years old together. She is 8 years older. How old is her brother?
items.why:
Let the brother be x. The girl is x + 8.
x + (x + 8) = 34.
2x + 8 = 34, so 2x = 26.
x = 13, and she is 21.
21 is her age, not her brother's.

items.text: Horizontal lines: which is the equation of a horizontal line?
items.why:
Horizontal lines have the form y = b.
y + 1 = 0 gives y = −1: horizontal.
x − 2 = 0 and x = 0 are vertical.
y = 4x is a slanted line.

items.text: Write in symbols: "nine more than twice a number" is:
items.why:
Twice a number is 2x.
Nine more means add 9.
So it is 2x + 9.
2(x + 9) adds 9 before doubling.

items.text: Remove the brackets and simplify: 5x − (3x − 1) − 6(7 − x).

items.why:
Shift −8x to the left and 36 to the right.
4x + 8x = 86 − 36.
12x = 50.
x = 50/12 = 25/6 = 4 1/6.

items.ask: Solve the equation with brackets: 2(6y − 18) − 102 = 78 − 18(y + 2). y = ___
Solve the equation with fractions: (2x + 7)/3 − (x − 9)/2 = 5/2. x = ___
Find the slope: the slope of the line y = x/2 is ___
items.why:
x/2 means (1/2) × x.
So y = (1/2)x.
Compare with y = mx: m = 1/2.

items.ask: Solve the word problem: 16 less than four times a number is 12. The number is ___
items.why:
Four times a number is 4x. 16 less: 4x − 16.
4x − 16 = 12.
4x = 28, so x = 7.
Check: 28 − 16 = 12.

items.ask: Solve the word problem: the sum of one fifth of a number and 12 is 30. The number is ___
Ages: Bezawit is 8 years older than her sister. Their ages add up to 32. Bezawit is ___ years old.
items.why:
Let the sister be s. Bezawit is s + 8.
s + (s + 8) = 32.
2s + 8 = 32, so 2s = 24 and s = 12.
Bezawit is 12 + 8 = 20.
Check: 12 + 20 = 32.
